title: A link hidden inside words the write step replaced reads back green while those words hold no link
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd.
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: An inReplacedWords line is green on words that hold no anchor with an address.
It is red while those words still hold a link.
Any other hidden line is still held to an empty slot.

tests: a link hidden inside words the write step replaced is green while those words hold no link, red while they still do
a hidden line is green when the slot is empty and red while it still holds words
